claim_limits: every candidate repair is stable-model checked
descriptor, random-block, and exact-only controls share rows, seeds, and budget
no timing or hardware speedup claim is allowed without matched receipts

damaged_row.description: Satisfiable row guarded by an accepted trace and default absence of a false accept.

source_row.description: Satisfiable row guarded by an accepted trace and default absence of a false accept.

damaged_row.description: Unsatisfiable row where an upstream FSM contradiction triggers a hard constraint.

source_row.description: Unsatisfiable row where an upstream FSM contradiction triggers a hard constraint.

damaged_row.description: Ambiguous row with two default-negation repair choices over the sparse FSM branch.

source_row.description: Ambiguous row with two default-negation repair choices over the sparse FSM branch.

damaged_row.description: Default-negation row where no exception fact derives the safe default.

source_row.description: Default-negation row where no exception fact derives the safe default.

damaged_row.description: Contradiction row where an explicit fact is forbidden by a hard constraint.

source_row.description: Contradiction row where an explicit fact is forbidden by a hard constraint.

field_principles.asp_sparse_repair_claim_allowed: Opens only when descriptor-guided repair beats random-block repair under exact stable-model checks.
field_principles.descriptor_guided_success_rate: Measures active-descriptor repair only after stable-model validation.
field_principles.descriptor_mean_iterations: Counts exact stable-model checks for descriptor-guided repair without making a timing claim.
field_principles.exact_only_mean_iterations: Counts exact stable-model checks for the exact-only control without making a timing claim.
field_principles.exact_only_success_rate: Records exact-validator-only repair under the same row and budget denominator.
field_principles.field_principles: Keeps headline and gate fields annotated by evidence boundaries.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Provides a terminal evidence boundary without speedup language.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic ASP/FSM sparse repair with no LLM.
field_principles.llm_invoked: Prevents deterministic stable-model repair from being mistaken for live model inference.
field_principles.matched_timing_available: Gates any future timing language to authenticated matched measurements.
field_principles.no_model_specs_required: Confirms the deterministic repair evaluator has no model dependency to disclose.
field_principles.random_block_success_rate: Provides the matched same-budget random-block control on the same rows and seeds.
field_principles.random_mean_iterations: Counts exact stable-model checks for the random-block control without making a timing claim.
field_principles.row_family_breakdown: Keeps satisfiable, unsatisfiable, ambiguous, and default-negation outcomes separate.
field_principles.speedup_claim_allowed: Must remain false without matched authenticated timing.
field_principles.stable_model_checked_rate: Confirms every fixture row received stable-model validation evidence.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: Names focused tests and reused upstream ASP/FSM tests.
field_principles.upstream_asp_fsm_fixture: Pins the sparse repair panel to the exact ASP/FSM fixture it reuses.
